sources: Owner-approved twin cities gameplay, graphics and expansion roadmap, 14 November 2026
title: A Room for the Tide
prose: Water slides into the cove beneath the nesting shelf. Ulenna moves back one pace; the birds do not move at all.

choices.label: Wait on the path
choices.line: A small change in where we stand leaves the rest of the cove at ease.

choices.label: Watch the inlet
choices.line: The tide brings water into the rooms that nobody has tried to close.
